output.text: The morning fog had barely lifted when the group gathered near the trailhead for a bird-watching walk. Assume that Pia is the lead volunteer. Pia arrived a bit earlier than Ivo, carrying a worn pair of binoculars slung around her neck. Otto showed up next, greeting everyone with a cheerful wave and a thermos of coffee. Uma arrived shortly after Otto, adjusting her scarf against the cool air. Otto brought the first-aid kit. Dara came last, slightly out of breath from rushing along the gravel path, though still in time before the walk officially began. Ivo, at nearly six feet tall, towered over most of the others except Otto, who stood just an inch shorter. Ivo and Uma were on different teams. The group paused by a small pond where a heron stood motionless in the reeds, and everyone quietly raised their binoculars to watch. Uma and Dara were on different teams. Pia pointed out a woodpecker high in a nearby oak, its rhythmic tapping echoing through the trees. Ivo and Dara were on different teams. Otto, meanwhile, jotted notes about the sparrows flitting between the bushes, comparing their markings to a field guide. There were three teams. As the walk continued, the group crossed a wooden bridge, pausing to admire a pair of swans gliding across the water below, their reflections rippling gently in the morning light.  Dara, the youngest of the group, kept pace easily despite the uneven terrain, while Uma lagged slightly behind, absorbed in photographing a distant falcon soaring above the tree line.
